Common questions

How fast can I get my build?

Picnic benches usually go out in 1–2 days. Everything else is made to order — I'll give you a straight lead time when you order.

How do payments work?

Made-to-order builds need a small deposit to start — for example $40 on a firewood rack or $70 on a picnic bench — with the balance due when the piece is done. I'll confirm the exact terms by text before anything starts.

Do you deliver?

Pickup is in Sweet Home, OR. Local delivery is available for a fee on racks, benches, and firewood racks — mention your town when you message me.

Can I supply my own lumber?

Yes — mention it in your message. If you bring lumber, I can often bring the price down.

What do you need from me for a restoration quote?

Photos of the piece, where it wobbles or what's worn, and what you'd like it to look like when it's done. I'll quote you after I've seen it.
